improvement.note: Magnification above 1.0 means the albedo is upscaled on screen. The rejected checkpoint upscaled its source about 5.9x at the delivered width; under the target the R2 detail window is sampled at 0.56x, i.e. the frame now sees more source texels than delivered pixels.

method: Frame width at the AOI from shot_plan.analyze on the last camera keyframe; texel size from each texture's equirectangular dimensions with the east-west size scaled by cos(latitude); magnification = metres per texel / metres per delivered pixel. The active texture under the target is the detail window wherever the frame lies inside it, which it does at the hold by construction.
